replies.body:
Greetings, dudesn.

Evidence for your punishment has been provided. Between us three, it seems that someone is lying.

Your appeal will be denied and you will have to wait a minimum of six months before submitting another. I hope you learn your lesson by facing proper consequences.

Sincerely,
- Vinnx | Senior Moderator.
